summary: Stone Point Credit Income Fund filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to declare a $0.22 per share distribution for April 2026 with record date April 30, 2026 and payment date May 20, 2026. The distribution is payable in cash or reinvested shares under the distribution reinvestment plan. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation or corporate event. There are no deal terms, party changes, or strategic actions involved. The filing confirms ordinary course fund operations with no risk-arb or event-driven angle.
